scripts.text: Go and train yourself in preparation for the holy war that is coming. Victory will be in the hands of those who are most ready to receive it.
scripts.translation: 去好好磨練自己，為即將到來的聖戰做好準備。勝利屬於準備最充分的人。

scripts.text: You don't belong here, my friend.
Be advised to continue practicing yourself.
Go and train yourself in preparation for the holy war that is coming. Victory will be in the hands of those who are most ready to receive it.
scripts.translation: 去好好磨練自己，為即將到來的聖戰做好準備。勝利屬於準備最充分的人。

scripts.text: Chaos will one day arise to challenge our principles of peace, justice and order. Until we have eliminated evil and created our ideal world, we must not cease training.
scripts.translation: 總有一天，混亂會興起，挑戰我們堅守的和平、正義與秩序。在消滅邪惡、創造理想世界之前，我們絕不能停止訓練。

scripts.text: to fight in the Holy War.
If you wish to join us, you must first learn the Swordsman discipline and train yourself thoroughly...
scripts.translation: 想加入我們，就先學好劍士的技藝，充分磨練自己...

scripts.text: to fight in the Holy War.
As it happened one thousand years ago, evil forces will one day attack in droves in an attempt to take over the world once again.
scripts.translation: 邪惡勢力終有一天會像千年前那樣大舉來襲，妄圖再次掌控世界。

scripts.text: I see that you have been called to become a Crusader. We are assured of your will, but now we must test your capabilities.
scripts.translation: ..看來你已蒙召，註定要成為十字軍。你的意志已得到認可，接下來還需考驗你的能力。

scripts.text: Meet with Moorenak Miyol who is training in the underground dungeon of the Prontera Castle. Go, and speak with him first.
scripts.translation: 穆爾納克·米茹爾正在普隆德拉王宮的地下城里訓練。先去找他談談吧。

scripts.text: Moorenak and others like him will test the limits of your capabilities and help you find your path. Return to me after you have completed their tests...
scripts.translation: 穆爾納克和其他人會考驗你的能力極限，幫你找到自己的道路。完成他們的考驗後，再回來找我...

scripts.text: We are Crusaders, warriors preparing for the Holy War.
scripts.translation: 我們是十字軍，是為聖戰做準備的戰士。

scripts.text: I want to prepare for the Holy War!
I am Michael Halig. I am one of but many Crusaders preparing for the Holy War. We continuously train ourselves with sincere faith and endless loyalty.
scripts.translation: 我是邁克爾·哈利格，是眾多為聖戰做準備的十字軍之一。我們懷著虔誠的信仰和堅定不移的忠誠，不斷磨練自己。

scripts.text: We recruit Swordsmen that express exceptional faith, or those who were born as warriors
scripts.translation: 我們招募信仰堅定的劍士，以及遵循奧丁意志、天生為戰

scripts.text: Possessing the ^3355FFChivalry Emblem^000000 and ^3355FFHand of God^000000 is seen as a sign that you have been called to become a Crusader.
scripts.translation: 擁有忠誠之證和神之手，就被視為蒙召成為十字軍的標誌。 ^3355FF^000000^3355FF^000000

scripts.text: After obtaining those items and passing our tests, you too, can become a Crusader.
scripts.translation: 獲得這些物品並通過我們的考驗後，你也能成為十字軍。

scripts.text: I don't know what type of person you are right now though. But
scripts.translation: 我還不瞭解你是怎樣的人，不過只要你

scripts.text: I shall test you if you desire. Are you willing to endure these tests in preparation for the Holy War?
scripts.translation: 願意，我就會考驗你。為了迎接聖戰，你願意接受這些考驗嗎？

scripts.text: I'd like to think about it.
You need to be at least
Train yourself more as a Swordsman and wait for your calling. I understand your intent, but as of now, you cannot join us.
scripts.translation: 繼續以劍士的身份磨練自己，等待召喚吧。我明白你的志向，不過現在還不能讓你加入。

scripts.text: You haven't finished learning everything as a Swordsman. Use all of your remaining skill points, and then return to me.
scripts.translation: 你還沒有完成劍士的學習。把剩餘

scripts.text: I shall test you to see if you are fit to become a Crusader.
scripts.translation: ..我會考驗你，看你是否有資格成為十字軍。

scripts.text: I see that you have been called to become a Crusader. We are assured of your will, but now we must test your capabilities.
scripts.translation: ..看來你已蒙召，註定要成為十字軍。你的意志已得到認可，接下來還需考驗你的能力。

scripts.text: Meet with Moorenak Miyol who is training in the underground dungeon of the Prontera Castle. Go, and speak with him first.
scripts.translation: 穆爾納克·米茹爾正在普隆德拉王宮的地下城里訓練。先去找他談談吧。

scripts.text: Moorenak and others like him will test the limits of your capabilities and help you find your path. Return to me after you have completed their tests...
scripts.translation: 穆爾納克和其他人會考驗你的能力極限，幫你找到自己的道路。完成他們的考驗後，再回來找我...

scripts.text: Mmm. I can't discern whether or not you have the heart to become a Crusader. However, if you have the will and put forth the effort, you may have what it takes.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我還看不出你是否有成為十字軍的決心。不過，只要意志堅定、肯付出努力，你也許就有這份資質。

scripts.text: This is my test for you. Bring me the following items and prove your determination to me.
scripts.translation: ...這就是我給你的考驗。帶來以下物品，向我證明你的決心。

scripts.text: Show me the strength of your will by gathering these items. If you prove successful, you will progress to the next test. May Odin protect you.
scripts.translation: 收集這些物品，證明你的意志有多堅定。完成後，就能接受下一項考驗。願奧丁護佑你。

scripts.text: Nobody knows when the Holy War will come. We must prepare in advance and cannot afford to slacken
scripts.translation: 沒人知道聖戰何時到來。我們必須提前準備，訓練一刻也不

scripts.text: If you feel that participating in the Holy War is your calling, please come back right away and take the test to become
scripts.translation: 如果你覺得參加聖戰是自己的使命，就儘快回來接受轉職十字軍的

scripts.text: If you, too, are a man of the sword, constantly train and prepare yourself. No one knows when the Holy War may begin.
scripts.translation: 既然你也是劍士，就要不斷磨練自己，做好準備。沒人知道聖戰何時會開始。

scripts.text: As a woman of the sword, you must train diligently and constantly. Prepare yourself, for no one knows when the Holy War may be coming.
scripts.translation: 身為女劍士，你必須堅持勤奮訓練，做好準備。沒人知道聖戰何時會到來。

scripts.text: Have you proven your determination with the task I have given you, or do you possess the items proving that you have received your calling?
scripts.translation: 你是否完成了我交給你的任務，證明自己的決心？或是帶來了能證明你已蒙召的物品？

scripts.text: I must acknowledge your efforts and determination. You may now proceed to take the next test.
scripts.translation: 好。你的努力和決心已得到認可。現在可以接受下一項考驗了。

scripts.text: Meet with Moorenak Miyol who is training in the underground dungeon of the Prontera Castle. Go, and speak with him first.
scripts.translation: 穆爾納克·米茹爾正在普隆德拉王宮的地下城里訓練。先去找他談談吧。

scripts.text: Moorenak and others like him will test the limits of your capabilities and help you find your path. Return to me after you have completed their tests...
scripts.translation: 穆爾納克和其他人會考驗你的能力極限，幫你找到自己的道路。完成他們的考驗後，再回來找我...

scripts.text: Ah, you still have not completed the task I have given to you. Bring me the following items, and prove your will to become a Crusader to me...
scripts.translation: 啊，你還沒完成我交給你的任務。帶來以下物品，向我證明你成為十字軍的決心...

scripts.text: If you put forth the effort, you'll be able to accomplish this task. May Odin protect you on your journeys.
scripts.translation: 只要肯努力，就能完成這項任務。願奧丁護佑你的旅途。

scripts.text: You haven't finished learning everything as a Swordsman. Use all of your remaining skill points, and then return to me.
scripts.translation: 的技能點全部用完，再回來找我。

scripts.text: Congratulations on completing all of your tests. You are truly worthy of fighting alongside side us in the Holy War as a Crusader.
scripts.translation: 恭喜你通過所有考驗。你確實有資格成為十字軍，在聖戰中與我們並肩作戰。

scripts.text: Together, let us ready ourselves and be victorious over evil and tyranny!
scripts.translation: 讓我們共同做好準備，戰勝邪惡與暴政！

scripts.text: When the Holy War comes, we shall fight side by side against the forces of evil.
scripts.translation: 十字軍了！聖戰來臨時，我們將並肩對抗邪惡勢力。
現在，你也是我們的一員了！...戰友。

scripts.text: And use this in times of dire peril. It will give you strength when your wounds are most grievous.
scripts.translation: 危急時就使用這個。當你傷勢嚴重時，它會為你帶來力量。

scripts.text: Never forget that the Holy War is approaching. We must be prepare for the inevitable tide of evil that will sweep this world. Now, go forth and fight for the principles of freedom and justice!
scripts.translation: 別忘了，聖戰正在逼近。邪惡的浪潮終將席捲世界，我們必須做好準備。現在，出發吧，為自由與正義而戰！

scripts.text: It seems that you have not yet completed all of the testing. You will not be ready to become a Crusader until you have completed the tests set before you.
scripts.translation: 看來你還沒完成所有考驗。通過這些考驗後，你才能成為十字軍。

scripts.text: Return to me when you have completed all of your tests. When you finally prove eligible, you will join the proud ranks of the mighty Crusaders.
scripts.translation: 完成所有考驗後，再來找我。當你證明自己的資格，就能加入強大而光榮的十字軍行列。

scripts.text: Don't linger around in a place like this and forge your own path towards discovering your own strengths. The day that we will join hands in battle will come soon.
scripts.translation: 別在這種地方逗留，去開闢自己的道路，發掘自身的力量吧。我們並肩作戰的日子很快就會到來。

scripts.text: Let me assure you that I'm no criminal. I'm here merely to train myself. Perhaps as you become stronger, you will understand.
scripts.translation: 放心，我不是罪犯，只是在這裡修行。等你變得更強，也許就會明白了。

scripts.text: Hm. You have no business in a place like this. Please leave, and do not interrupt my training.
scripts.translation: 嗯，這裡沒有你的事。請離開，別打擾我的修行。

scripts.text: If you have no business here,
then please leave. A tranquil state of mind is essential in self training...
scripts.translation: 話，就請離開。修行必須保持心境平和...

scripts.text: I wish to improve the sense of serenity in my heart in preparation for the Holy War that is to come. So please, do not disturb me.
scripts.translation: 為了迎接聖戰，我正在修煉，讓內心更加平靜。所以請別打擾我。

scripts.text: with me, man of the sword?
with me, woman of the sword?
scripts.translation: 怎麼了...？女劍士，你找我有事嗎？

scripts.text: I'd like to take the Crusader test.
You wish to become a Crusader...? Hm, fighting in the Holy War is an admirable goal we may both share.
scripts.translation: 你想成為十字軍...？嗯，為聖戰而戰是個崇高的目標，也許你我志向相同。

scripts.text: Hmm. You wish to become a Crusader, but do not wear a Rosary? I have no business with you if you cannot uphold our customs.
scripts.translation: 嗯，想成為十字軍，卻不佩戴念珠？連我們的傳統都不遵守，我也沒什麼好跟你說的。

scripts.text: You seem so-so, but also young and ambitious. Ambition may work against you if it is not tempered with patience.
scripts.translation: ..你看起來資質平平，不過年輕而有抱負。沒有耐心約束，抱負也可能成為阻礙。

scripts.text: Don't give me a reason to doubt you, and show me your patience. You must endure my test with your patience if you wish to become a Crusader.
scripts.translation: 別讓我懷疑你，證明你的耐心吧。想成為十字軍，就得耐心承受我的考驗。

scripts.text: You may take my test right away. It's actually quite simple. All you must do is walk to the end of the corridor.
scripts.translation: 現在就可以開始。考驗很簡單，只要走到走廊盡頭就行。

scripts.text: You must keep one thing in mind. Under no condition are you allowed to kill the monsters.
scripts.translation: ...有一點必須記住：無論如何，都不許殺死魔物。

scripts.text: You seem to have a lot of time on your hands. Why don't you do something more productive, like pick Jellopy off the streets or something?
scripts.translation: 你似乎很閒啊。不如做點有用的事，比如去街上撿些傑勒比結晶？

scripts.text: You're the Swordman from before. What happened, did you fail?
scripts.translation: 怎麼了...？是之前那位劍士啊。沒通過考驗嗎？

scripts.text: What kind of test was that?!
I'll let you retake the test as much as you like. But if you continuously fail, there's an inherent problem with your
scripts.translation: 想重考多少次都可以。不過，如果一直失敗，那就是心態有問

scripts.text: Where have you left your Rosary? You can't let that lie around just anywhere. We are supposed to be warriors of holiness.
scripts.translation: ...你把念珠放哪了？可不能隨便亂放。我們是神聖的戰士。

scripts.text: Carelessly losing things is an attitude for mere Swordsmen. If you really want to retake the test, you must respect the Crusader traditions.
scripts.translation: 粗心大意、丟三落四，那是普通劍士的做派。真想重考，就得尊重十字軍的傳統。

scripts.text: Your problem is your habit of hitting monsters the moment you see one. You must develop your patience and endurance.
scripts.translation: 你的問題就是看見魔物就動手。必須學會忍耐，磨練耐力。

scripts.text: Your only goal is to walk from one end of the corridor to the other. It's simple when you think
scripts.translation: ..你的目標只有一個，就是從走廊這頭走到那頭。想清楚了，其實很

scripts.text: No matter what you do, do not kill any of the monsters. This time, think carefully before you draw your sword.
scripts.translation: 無論做什麼，都不能殺死魔物。這次拔劍之前，先想清楚。

scripts.text: Who are you to say that you don't like my test? With that kind of attitude, you'll never become a Crusader.
scripts.translation: 憑什麼嫌棄我的考驗？這種態度，永遠當不了十字軍。

scripts.text: I can understand if you are easily frustrated, but you must overcome your frustration to pass this test.
scripts.translation: 容易受挫，我可以理解。不過，想通過考驗，你就得克服這種情緒。

scripts.text: Hmm, seems like you did well. It shouldn't have been too hard. You no longer have any business
scripts.translation: 嗯，看來你做得不錯。應該不算太難吧。我這裡已經沒有你的

scripts.text: For your next test, go look for Gabriel Valentine in the Prontera Sanctuary. Well then, I'll see you around.
scripts.translation: 下一項考驗，去普隆德拉聖堂找加布裡埃爾·瓦倫丁。那麼，回頭見。

scripts.text: You still have tests to complete if you want to become a Crusader, don't you?
scripts.translation: ..想成為十字軍，你還有其他考驗要完成，不是嗎？

scripts.text: You must not forget to train everyday, and prepare for the day the Holy War will come upon us.
scripts.translation: 記得每天訓練，為聖戰降臨的那一天做好準備。

scripts.text: If you are interested in becoming a Crusader, you must train first as a Swordman. Come and visit us again when you believe that you have learned enough as a Swordman...
scripts.translation: 想成為十字軍，必須先以劍士的身份磨練自己。等你覺得劍士的本領已經學得足夠紮實，再來找我們...

scripts.text: We are located in the Prontera Central Palace, so if you have time, it wouldn't hurt to stop by.
scripts.translation: 我們在普隆德拉中央王宮，有空不妨過來看看。

scripts.text: I hope you will train yourself in preparation for the future as well.
scripts.translation: 希望你能為了未來而不斷磨練自己。
歡迎。我們是十字軍。我們正在為預言中的

scripts.text: If you would like to become a Crusader, please speak with our leader in the Prontera Central Palace.
scripts.translation: 如果想成為十字軍，請去普隆德拉中央王宮找我們的首領談談。

scripts.text: I will be conducting your next test.
scripts.translation: 順利嗎？下一項考驗由我來主持。

scripts.text: My name is Gabriel Valentine. I, too, am preparing for the Holy War. For the time being, I act as guard for this church.
scripts.translation: 我叫加布裡埃爾·瓦倫丁，也在為聖戰做準備。目前負責守衛這座教堂。

scripts.text: I will test to see if you have acquired the knowledge that is necessary to become a Crusader.
scripts.translation: 我會考驗你，看看你是否掌握了十字軍必備的知

scripts.text: We can't very well win the Holy War just by swinging a sword.
scripts.translation: 識。光靠揮劍可贏不了聖戰。

scripts.translation: 5. 以下哪種魔物的體型與其他魔物不同？

scripts.translation: 7. 殭屍和妖道生前是什麼關係？

scripts.translation: 8. 以下哪種魔物不會主動攻擊？

scripts.translation: 1. 以下哪種魔物的屬性與其他魔物不同？

scripts.translation: 2. 哪把劍能有效攻擊惡魔系魔物？

scripts.translation: 3. 以下哪項物品不是土人掉落的？

scripts.translation: 4. 以下哪種惡魔系魔物的 HP 最高？

scripts.translation: 5. 以下哪種惡魔系魔物的體型與其他魔物不同？

scripts.translation: 6. 哪面盾牌能減少惡魔系魔物造成的傷害？

scripts.translation: 7. 用哪種屬性攻擊風魔巫師最有效？

scripts.translation: 8. 以下哪種魔物不屬於惡魔系？

scripts.translation: 9. 傀儡娃娃卡片有什麼效果？

scripts.text: Increase defense against Shadow attacks by 30 %
scripts.translation: 對暗屬性攻擊的防禦力提升30%

scripts.text: Increase defense against poison attacks by 30 %
scripts.translation: 對毒屬性攻擊的防禦力提升30%

scripts.text: Increase defense against Ghost attacks by 30 %
scripts.translation: 對念屬性攻擊的防禦力提升30%

scripts.text: Increase defense against Neutral attacks by 30 %
scripts.translation: 對無屬性攻擊的防禦力提升30%

scripts.translation: 10. 遇到惡魔系魔物時，以下哪種應對方式有效？

scripts.text: Offer your soul and get a deal.
Put Holy Water on a weapon and attack.
scripts.translation: 在武器上塗聖水後攻擊

scripts.translation: 1. 需要多少級的“天使之護”才能學習“天使之擊”？

scripts.translation: 2. 角色等級為55，包含裝備加成的 INT 為30時，5級治癒術能恢復多少 HP？

scripts.text: 3. With Level 7 Divine Protection, by how much is your defense against the Undead increased?
scripts.translation: 3. 7級天使之護能提高多少對不死系魔物的防禦力？

scripts.translation: 4. 以下哪把長矛能攻擊念屬性的夢魘？

scripts.text: 5. What level of 'Heal' do you need to learn 'Cure?'
scripts.translation: 5. 需要幾級治癒術才能學習治療術？

scripts.text: 6. What is the attack speed when Level 3 Cavalier Mastery is learned?
scripts.translation: 6. 學習3級騎兵修煉後的攻擊速度是多少？

scripts.translation: 7. 關於天使之擊，以下哪項描述不正確？
提高對不死系魔物的攻擊力

scripts.text: Only Acolytes can learn the skill
